title: unified-rollouts-enhanced-canary-shadow-autorollback-observability
author: Eleanor Park
description: Motivation: improve observability and safety around automated rollbacks for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow). This PR centralizes rollback telemetry, adds per-stage and per-route metrics, integrates composite metric matching for quorum-based rollbacks, and wires these metrics into Console dashboards and alerting rules. Scope: - Add metrics emission for rollback decisions (decision_reason, metric_set, quorum_state, probe_results) - Expose rollback decision traces via tracing hooks (trace id propagation) - Extend rollout controller to emit stage-level histograms and counters for canary/shadow/probing stages - Add a configurable quarantine (manual/auto) stage that pauses rollout when metric quorum is ambiguous - Add observability dashboards and sample alert rules in redwood-console - Update rollout API schema with optional observability config (backwards compatible default) - Add e2e stability tests and unit tests for the metric matcher and autorollback engine Migration notes: rollout spec gains new optional block `observability:{enabled:bool, metric_prefix:string, composite_quorum:{threshold:int, quorum_size:int}}`. Existing rollouts are unaffected by default. Checklist: [x] Telemetry + metrics added and unit tested [x] Tracing hooks added and end-to-end tested on perf-canary cluster [x] Console dashboards wired and documented [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-3421, ENG-3490) [x] QA: canary canary/shadow experiments validated on staging [x] Release notes drafted. Related: PRs in platform and console will follow to expose new metrics. See ENG-3421 for design doc and metric names. Testing: local unit tests, integration tests against perf-canary (staging), and e2e stability harness added to eval-harness. Rollout: squash-merged into main after approvals. Impact: better fault visibility and safer automated rollback behavior; no breaking API changes by default.
